test_title: PYST 97: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 10 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MONTH’ is written as ‘141213719’ and ‘YEAR’ is written as ‘222269’. How will ‘WEEK’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : Position value of opposite letter according to English alphabetic series is written.

​So, 

 
• ‘MONTH’ is written as ‘141213719’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ba810912b7999fc9bea94c6c7f181bbc08a0d8963b5e3e2dca32bd662d9d6fe.png] 

 
• ‘YEAR’ is written as ‘222269’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b47f1aa3eeb3b24f4cd23d5d58783166db5a962353ea0a7ca82c54dad919d27.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ‘WEEK’ is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ca1a59b05763fb20eb0d9eaf23c526a4f04cb8f69006a8014003e3a40ba3f1.png] 

Hence, "**4222216**" is the correct answer.

86:Tf7
